༄༅/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod bcu pa bzhugs so//
lge/ /gter spon chen po rig 'dzin chong kyi lem 'pha can nam rig 'dzin ngangos gab rgyal mtshan gni/ bod rab byung drug pa'i me glang loga / tsho / / / / sa / da su / / / / / ༄ / /g.yas ru stod byang ga zang zang lha brag gi 'dabs rol ri rgyal bkra bzang gi mdun du bkra shos pa' ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ thugs rigs sad de zab mo baspungs 'dra'am lha brag nas bod khams bde zhing mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i chos skor rnams bse sgrom smug rya mdzod lnga'i nang nas rdzogs chen kun bzang dgobyung ba chos tshan brgya phrag lnga lhag spyan drangs shing shog ser las gtan la phab nas skal ldan las can rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ de bzhin gu ru padma'inai ba gnang nga/ 4 ba3da 'dzin ni sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang sdim mtshan ldan ma spruX pa'i 〉spra sbyin/ kun spaX don sbyod rgyal mtshan sogs thugazi kyi
༄tshi/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam bcu pa'i nang bzhugs/ shar dung mdzod dkar po nas byon pa'i bka' brgyad pod gnyis par/ bka' brgyad phyogs bsgrigs dkar chag la/3 (1) bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi pod gnyis pa'i dpe thor/5 (7) sgrub chen bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi bstod bskul las bzhi lhun grub ces bya bar/18 (17) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi bskul chung la/5 (53)sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkon mchog spyi bskul la/7 (63) bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi drag las bkol bar/5 (77) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi bden brdar chen mor/9 (87) bka' brgyad ral gri phyung brdeg gi bskul la/8 (105) tshe lung khrus lung la/2 (121) gu ru padmas mdzad pa'i zlog pa rig 'dzin lugs la/23 (125) sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi 'debs kha dgu dang las phran bcur/5 (171)sgrub chen bka' brgyad rgyud las byung ba'i phyi'i gtor mar/6 (181) bka' brgyad kyi nang gtor la/3 (193) bka' brgyad kyi gsang ba'i gtor mar/2 (199) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi rgyud las byung ba'i chu
gtor gyi rim par/5 (203) bka' brgyad kyi cha gsum gtor mar/7 (213) gu ru padmas mdzad pa'i cha gsum bsdus gtor la/2 (227) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi thun mong gi las rim la 5 (231) ngag gi nus 'don ngar blud padmas mdzad par/2 (241) sgrub pa bka' brgyad skurdzongs rje'ogs kyi dug khrag sbyar thabs la/3 (245) rang byung rang shar las bsrung ba:rdzog gnam lcags me 'bar la/2 (251) bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i drag sngags la/7 (255) drag po rang byung rang shar gyi zor dang sbyin sreg mnan pa gsum gyi las sbyor la/3 (269) thub chod kun dril gyi bzlog gzhung la/2 (275) ḍakki ma'i drag sngags seng gdong drag mo las tshogs dang bcas par/3 (279) bka' brgyad kyi cha rkyen rang byung rang shar man ngag snying gi ti gar/4 (285) bka' brgyad kyi skyin thang dbab pa yongs rdzogs la/3 (293) bka' brgyad drag po'i dmod pa drag sngags kyi sgrub pa zab mor/3 (299) chos skyong bstan srung 31ngas rdzogs las sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu'i las byang la/11 (305) sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu'i drag bskul rno myur thog 'drar/11 (327) dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu las phyi sgrub mdos kyi byang bur/18 (349) drag po rang byung rang shar gyi sde dpon sum cu'i phyi sgrub mdos kyi cho gar/5 (385) sde dpon sum cu'i sgrub pa'i gzhung
༄tsho/ /zhes bya bar/4 (395) dregs pa nang sgrub kyi gsol khar/2 (403) bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi sde dpon gsang sgrub las tshogs lnga bcu par/3 (407) sde dpon sum cu sgrub pa'i kha tshar dang bcas pa zhes bya bar/7 (413) dregs pa sum cu'i byang gter lugs kyi mngon rtogs brjed byang mdzad pa po mi gsal ba la/2 (427) chos skyong rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po'i rgyud la/3 (431) rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po'i phrin las zhes bya bar/5 (437) u ma'i bzlog pa che chung gsum la/6 (447) tshe dbang yongs rdzogs la/5 (459) bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar las sgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub yongs rdzogs la/4 (469) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar las tshe'i phrin las la/5 (477) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar las tshe'i bstod byang bkol bar/2 (487) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar las tshe'i phyi sgrub la/3 (491) sgrub chen bka' brgyad las tshe'i nang sgrub la/2 (497) sgrub chen bka' brgyad las tshe sgrub hrīXgacig mar/2 (501) sgrub chen bka' brgyad las yang gsang nam mkha'i rdo rjer/2(505) khyung chen gdug pa 'dul ba'i rgyud chen/4 (509) rgyal sras khyung gi sgrub thabs zab mor/4 (517) gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs la/9 (525) yum nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs la 2
(543) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha khrid yongs rdzogs la/8 (547) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi rdzogs rim khrid gzhung ye shes zang thal chen po zhes bya bar/9 (563) sgrub chen bka' brgyad las bar do'i man ngag la/4 (581) sgrub chen bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi rdzogs rim snying tig rnam pa bcu bstan par/4 (589) sgrub chen bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi snying po gnam zhal don khrid ces bya bar/6997) par spring smon tshigakyi (609—610) bcas bzhugs/ chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun du grags gyur te/ /blo gros padmo rab tu rgyas byed cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar

༄༅/ /bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi pod gnyis pa'i bzhugs byang la6/ bstod bskul las bzhi lhun grub ldeb 22/ bskul chung ldeb 5/ dkon mchog spyi bskul ldeb 7/ drag las bkol ba ldeb 6/ bden brdar chen mo ldeb 10/ ral gri phyung brdeg ldeb 10/ tshe khrus ldeb 1/ gu ru padmas mdzad pa'i bzlog pa ldeb 26/ 'debs kha dgu dang las phran bcu ldeb 5/ phyi'i gtor ma ldeb 6/ nang gtor ldeb 2/ gsang gtor ldeb 1/ chu gtor gyi rim pa ldeb 5/ cha gsum gtor ma ldeb 8/ cha gsum bsdus gtor ldeb 1/ thun mong gi las rim ldeb 5/ ngag gi nus 'don ldeb 1/ dug khrag sbyang thabs ldeb 2/ srung zlog gnam lcags me 'bar ldeb 1/ bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i drag sngags ldeb 8/ zor dang sbyin sreg mnan pa gsum ldeb 4/ thub chos kun dril gyis
༄༅/ /bzlog gzhung ldeb 2/ ḍākki ma'i drag sngags seng gdong drag po ldeb 4/ man ngag snying gi ti ka ldeb 4/ skyin thang dbab pa ldeb 4/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi sgrub pa sdeb 4/ sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu'i las byang ldeb 13/ drag bskul rno myur thog 'dra ldeb 13/ phyi sgrub mdos kyi byang bu ldeb 21/ phyi sgrub mdos kyi cho ga ldeb 6/ sde dpon sum bcu'i bsgrub pa'i gzhung ldeb 5/dregs pa nang bsgrub kyi gsol kha ldeb 1/ gsang sgrub las tshogs lnga bcu pa ldeb 3/ sde dpon sum bcu'i bsgrub pa'i kha tshang ldeb 10/ mngon rtogs brjod byang ldeb 1/ chos skyong rdo nde gnod sbyin nag po'i rgyud ldeb 4/ dreg pa'i phrin las ldeb 6/ u ma'i bzlog pa ldeb 9/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs ldeb 6/ sgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub ldeb 5/ tshe'i phrin las ldeb 6/ tshe'i bstod

༄༅/ /rim ldeb 3/ gtor ma'i dpe'u ris ldeb 3/ gang khyon tshan grangs bcas bzhugs pa la dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i bya ra dang mel tshe mdzod cig /oX swasti sindha/ gdod ma'i mgon po spros kun nyer zhi'i dbyings/ /rang byung rang las shar ba'i ye shes rtsal/ /rab 'byams sgrub sde brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor lha/ /rang rig 'od gsal thig ler rtag bzhugs gsol/ /1'og min chos dbyings kun bzang yab yum gyi dgongs pas rgyal tshab rigs lngar byin rlabs pas/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rdor sems thub dbang gis/ /rim dgu'i theg pa gsang ba'i bdag por rtsal/ /2de yi rgyud lung man ngag sgrub sde rnams/ /dbye bas rgyal po dzaXdang rig 'dzin dgur/ /sprul te dbang thob slob dpon rnam bzhi dang / /kun 'dus padmas mi yul snang bar mdzad/ /3rgyal rnes phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam yang / /gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon gcig mtsho skyes rjes/ /mchims phur rje 'bang nyer lngar bde 'dus dang / /thugs kyi bu dgur gsang rdzogs rang shar stsal/ /4ma 'ong gdul byar rjes brtses gter rgyas gdams/ /rig 'dzin grub thob gter ston rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i mchog sprul rnam gsum gyi/ /ya gyal gyur pa'i bka' babs sna nam pa'i/ /5rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can/ /dngos grub rgyal mtshan ny-i zla 'od 'bar
rtsal gang des byang phyogs zang zang lha brag nas/ /gangs can skyobs mdzad mdzod lnga'i chos gter bton/ /6dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs zab sgrub sde brgyad/ /kun gyi yang zab thugs srog dwangs ma'i bcud drag po rang byung rang shar 'di nyid yin/ /gsung rab kun las bka' brgyad rnam gsum 'di/ /7ches zab gnyen phyir nyams par mi rung gsungs/ /ḍākki dam can rgya mtsho'i bla rdo ste/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin nor/ /khyad par zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs 'di/ /8shes pas chog pa drin pas thar lam bsgrod/ /ye shes khyad 'phags lha yi lha mchog yin/ /bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod bgyis pa thams cad kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su mngon sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes/ /9bslu med rdo rje'i gsung gis ches cher bsngags/ /sgrub chen 'di yi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / /gu ru nyid dang thugs rgyud 'dres gsungs pas bka' brgyad rnam gsum tshul bzhin nyams blang pa/ /10ji snyed mchog dngos grub pa 'ba' zhig phyir/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi tshad ma'i dan dpang gyur/ /sa brgyad sems dpa' srid pa'i lha chen tshul/ /chos 'di'i bka' srung gnyen chen thang lha yis/ /11kun la phan bzhed rab dkar lhag bsam can/ /gser de'u bla ma bskal bzang mtshan can la/ /mnal lam lung bzhin mdo smad smar shod ljongs/ /a nag lding
༄tshi/ /dpon mchog de'i legs byas zla/ /12 sngon smon bsod nam dge ba'i pad rdzing du/ /bstan 'gro'i rgud mun sel ba'i dpal du shar/ /gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs kyi/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med spar kyi yid bzhin gter/ /13'dis mtshon rang gzhan dus gsum legs byas kun/ /bla na ma mchis byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar mdzad phrin stobs/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /14srid pa'i rgya mtsho rmid nas stong byed pa/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa bdag gis rdzogs byed shog /dam chos rin chen byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon 'gro kun rgyud la smin 15las nyon sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras med gzhil nas/ /dad dang nges 'byung byang chub sems ldan phre(ga /nang mkhon rme 'khrugs 'ordzo nyes nad yams dang / /bdud rigs 'byung pos 'tshe sogs rgud pa kun/ /16rab zhi 'jig rten bde zhing 'byor pa rgyas/ /rgyal bstan la gus dge bcu rtag spyod shog /rnam dkar 'dir 'bad sbyin pa'i bdag po yi/ /sku ngo 'das bzhugs 'brel par bcas rnams kyis/ /17thogs med nas bsags sdig ltung nyes tshogs kun/ /byang zhing dag nas tshogs gnyis dpal gyis 'byor/ /sku tshe ring zhing mnga' thang 'o1ngas spyod rgyas/ /chos mthun legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /18skye kun gu
rus rjes bzung theg mchog gi /lam las myur du rdzogs sangs rgyas 'thob the ga /'jig rten kun tu lung rtogs rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pas dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /19khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i ye shes nyi snying la shar bas grub 'bras mngon smin ༄rdzog /mkha' la rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sprin chen 'khrigs/ /bar du bskyed rdzogs smin grol gru char 'bebs/ /20sa 'dir dam ldan rnal 'byor grub pa'i tshogs/ /'og min zhing gi dpal la dbang 'byor shog /ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe rab brtan thugs bzhed chos bzhin 'grub/ /21dge 'dun sde 'phel thugs mthun 'dul khrims gtsang / /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gong 'phel shog /'jig rten skye dgu dkon mchog gsum la gus/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'gro rgyud la zhugs pas/ /22lta ba log dang bstan 'gror 'tshe ba'i dpung / /ming yang mi drag bde skyid chos spyod shog /23'gro 'di dam chos gdugs dkar grib bsil du/ /dge bcu mig rab gsal ba'i gser gyi nywa/ /gtan don grub pa'i ptaXdmo 'dabs stong bzhad/ /theg mchog dgaXl gyi spuX 'u 'od du 'bar 24 phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rin cheneX busaX bzuX nga kheng / /chos bzhin spyod pa rab dkar g.yas 'khyil dnghaXng / /skye kun 'khoX ra ldoX bzhi ldan rton bzang las/ /thar mchog rgaXl mtshuX na 'dzin pa'i bkra
༄༅/ /shis shog /25rab dkar smon don dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi/ /thugs rje byin rlabs bden mthus legs grub pa'i/ /bkra shis dge legs ngo mtshar rmad po che/ /srid zhi'i dge tshogs rtag brtan bkra shis shog /zhes pa'ang shākya'i dge slong spong ban pa thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtshos rang gnas dben pa'i ri sul du smon pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o/ /chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu grags gyur te/ /blo gros padmo rab tu rgyas byed cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par rtsodag /oX ye dharma he tu pra bha bā he tunti ṣānta tha ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā rwi ma hā sha ma 45
